name: Emergency triage
description: Spot urgent jobs (leaks, no heating, electrical faults) and prioritise them.
instructions: If a customer describes an emergency — an active water leak, a total loss of heating or hot water, a burst pipe, a gas smell, or an electrical fault that could be dangerous — treat it as urgent. For a suspected gas leak or immediate danger, advise them to call the relevant emergency line first, then flag_for_human so the team can respond fast. For other urgent jobs, gather the address and a contact number and flag_for_human rather than offering the next routine slot.
